function logged(target: ClassAccessorDecoratorTarget<Counter, number>, context: ClassAccessorDecoratorContext<Counter, number>) {
  return {
    get(this: Counter) {
      console.log('get', String(context.name), context.private);
      return target.get.call(this);
    },
  };
}
class Counter {
  accessor count = 0;
  static accessor total = 10;
  accessor #hidden = 7;
  @logged accessor #logged = 3;
  read() {
    return this.#hidden + this.#logged;
  }
}
const counter = new Counter();
counter.count++;
console.log(counter.count, Counter.total, counter.read(), new Counter().read(), Object.keys(counter));
